blocks.tamil_translation: difficult to avoid). However, one of the two did not guard himself against drops of urine touching his body, and the other went about carrying tales.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: لَمَّا عُرِجَ بِيْ مَرَرْتُ بِقَوْمٍ، لَهُمْ اَظْفَارٌ مِنْ نُحَاسٍ يَخْمِشُوْنَ وُجُوْهَهُمْ وَصُدُوْرَهُمْ، فَقُلْتُ: مَنْ هؤُلَاءِ يَا جِبْرِيْلُ؟ قَالَ: هؤُلَاءِ الَّذِيْنَ يَأْكُلُوْنَ لُحُوْمَ النَّاسِ وَيَقَعُوْنَ فِيْ اَعْرَاضِهِمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب في الغيبة، رقم:٤٨٧٨
blocks.tamil_translation: “When I went on the journey to the heavens, I passed by a group of people. Their nails were made of copper, and with them they were scratching and wounding their faces and chests. I asked Hazrat Jibra'il (AS), “Who are these?' Hazrat Jibra'il (AS) said, “These are the ones who ate the flesh of people, backbiting about people and robbing them of their honour.”” Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ﵄ قَالَ: كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَارْتَفَعَتْ رِيْحٌ مُنْتِنَةٌ.فَقَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: أَتَدْرُوْنَ مَا هذِهِ الرِّيْحُ؟ هذِهِ رِيْحُ الَّذِيْنَ يَغْتَابُوْنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد ورجاله ثقات، مجمع الزوائد: ٨ /١٧٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jabir ibn Abdullah (RA) says, “When we were sitting with the Prophet ﷺ, a foul smell spread. The Prophet ﷺ said, “Do you know whose foul smell this is? This is the foul smell coming from those who backbite about Muslims.”
